title: Rio

description.en: A web voice interface for local Hermes agents, powered by GPT-Live and Cloudflare
description.zh: 通过 GPT-Live 与 Cloudflare 连接本地 Hermes Agent 的网页语音界面

websiteSource: wrangler.jsonc at 371b2042f3d6e42b290956036a8b52d9dcc14659; production /api/live verified HTTP 200 JSON with no-store on 2026-09-20
subject: Colorful fragmented scarlet macaw watching one drifting feather

description.en: A handsome scarlet macaw turns toward one nearby drifting feather. The left-offset head and broad folded wings form a compact portrait; the shoulder and chest continue naturally through the lower frame.
description.zh: 绯红金刚鹦鹉从容望向身旁飘落的一枚羽毛。偏左的头部与宽阔折翼构成饱满肖像，肩羽和胸部自然延伸至画面下方。

title.zh: 连贯切面中的丰富色彩

description.en: Connected flat facets cover the crown, ivory cheek, hooked beak, chest and wings. Scarlet leads the natural gold, emerald, turquoise and cobalt plumage requested by the owner.
description.zh: 冠羽、象牙色面颊、钩喙、胸部和双翼均由连贯平面碎片构成。绯红为主，搭配金黄、翠绿、青绿与钴蓝，呈现明确要求的多彩羽色。

description.en: Palm fronds and broad heliconia leaves form a quiet warm coral paper field, inspired by the macaw’s tropical forest habitat. Authored geometry, fine grain and contact shadows stay separate from the animal.
description.zh: 棕榈叶与宽阔的赫蕉叶构成温暖、安静的珊瑚色纸面，呼应金刚鹦鹉的热带森林栖息地。独立绘制的纹样、细纸粒与接触阴影均与动物前景分离。

palette.source: artwork/logo-family/rio/2026-09-20-01/presentation.json background.base; authored presentation, not an application theme token

sizeNote.en: At 24/16px the scarlet head, strong beak and blue-gold wing grouping remain legible; fine cheek facets and the separate feather soften. Use the transparent foreground without another tile or mask.
sizeNote.zh: 24/16px 下仍能识别绯红头部、鲜明鸟喙与蓝金翼羽；面颊碎片和独立羽毛的细节会柔化。小标志使用透明前景，不另加底板或遮罩。

source.description: A web voice interface for local Hermes agents, powered by GPT-Live and Cloudflare

goal.en: Talk naturally with your own Hermes agents from any browser. Rio brings GPT-Live voice conversations, real-time answers and local tool execution into one private workspace, with seamless switching between machines, gateways and agent profiles.
goal.zh: 在任何浏览器中，与自己的 Hermes Agent 自然交谈。Rio 将 GPT-Live 实时语音、即时回答与本地工具执行融入私有工作区，随时切换机器、网关和 Agent 配置。

role.en: Responsive browser workspace and conversation controls
role.zh: 响应式浏览器工作区与会话控制

role.en: Authenticated API, encrypted gateway credentials and conversation state
role.zh: 认证 API、加密网关凭据与会话状态

role.en: Private connectivity to independently selectable local agent gateways
role.zh: 安全连接可独立选择的本地 Agent 网关

role.en: Real-time voice conversation and natural spoken interaction
role.zh: 实时语音对话与自然口语交互

description.en: Sweeping palm fronds and broad heliconia leaves evoke the scarlet macaw’s tropical forest habitat in quiet shallow relief.
description.zh: 舒展的棕榈叶与宽阔赫蕉叶，以安静的浅浮雕呼应绯红金刚鹦鹉的热带森林栖息地。

alt.en: Colorful fragmented scarlet macaw watching one drifting feather on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: Rio，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.en: A little clarity. A natural conversation.
caption.zh: 让思路清晰，让对话自然。

description.en: A colorful macaw for natural voice conversations with your own Hermes agents.
description.zh: 以帅气多彩的金刚鹦鹉，连接你与自己的 Hermes Agent。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Keep the existing portrait's natural frame entry. The full square is placed against the baseline; no anatomy is extended, trimmed or masked. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留原头像自然入框的边界，将完整方形画布贴齐基线；不补画、不截取解剖结构。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥39px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine material detail softens at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 39px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小材质细节会柔化。
